summary: Medirom Healthcare Technologies Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing the notice of convocation and proxy materials for its 26th Ordinary General Meeting of Shareholders to be held on May 29, 2026, in Tokyo, Japan. The meeting agenda includes approval of financial statements and re-election of directors along with election of one new director. The board recommends a vote FOR each proposal. This is a routine annual shareholder meeting notice, equivalent to a proxy statement under US regulations, with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or management change.
